parsed.note_claim: NATO provides aid to Ukraine but is not directly engaged in combat with Russia and has no troops deployed there.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Why isn't NATO sending troops or closing the skies over Ukraine? ... Enforcing a no-fly zone or deploying combat troops to Ukraine would bring NATO forces into direct conflict with Russia.
parsed.reason: The page confirms NATO is not sending troops and explains that deploying combat troops would result in direct conflict, substantiating the note's claim about NATO's non-combat status.
